question.text: Which of the following methods of buyback is prohibited at all times under SEBI Regulations, irrespective of the cut-off date for stock exchange purchases?

answer.text: Negotiated deals whether on or off the stock exchange
Open market through book building process

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI Buyback Regulations prohibit buyback through negotiated deals, whether on or off the stock exchange, alongside spot transactions and private arrangements; this prohibition is not time-bound (NISM-Series-IX workbook, p.221). The Trap: Tender offers (proportionate or to existing shareholders) and open market through book building remain available routes; the stem is intentionally framed to exclude the stock-exchange route, which the workbook on p.221 states is not allowed with effect from April 1, 2025. Note: Treat the ban on negotiated deals on p.221 as the permanent prohibition, separate from the April 1, 2025 cut-off that removed the stock-exchange open-market route.
